about.title: From Zoology to AI — My Journey
paragraphs: I'm Md Tanbir Hossen Joy — an AI Data Specialist based in Bangladesh with a unique path from biological sciences to artificial intelligence.

Currently working as a Data Annotator at iMerit and as a freelance AI data professional across platforms like RWS TrainAI Community and Appen CrowdGen, I specialize in training and evaluating the AI models that power tomorrow's technology.

My academic background in Zoology at Hajee Mohammad Danesh Science and Technology University (HSTU) taught me precision in observation and classification — skills that translate perfectly to AI data annotation and quality assurance. I've also completed a Prompt Engineering Bootcamp through Ostad and am currently enrolled in an AI/ML Engineering Bootcamp to deepen my technical expertise.
Beyond my core work, I serve as a Campus Ambassador for English Carnival Bangladesh and ICT Olympiad Bangladesh, championing digital literacy and language skills in my community.

items.title: AI Image Quality Evaluation
items.description: Led systematic evaluation of large-scale image datasets for AI model training at iMerit. Developed and applied quality rating frameworks to assess image clarity, relevance, and labeling accuracy — ensuring training data met rigorous standards for computer vision models. Processed thousands of images across multiple evaluation criteria, contributing to improved model performance through higher-quality training data.

items.title: AI Data Annotation & Model Evaluation
items.description: Performed multi-platform AI data annotation and model output evaluation across iMerit, RWS TrainAI Community, and Appen CrowdGen. Specialized in labeling diverse datasets — from text classification to LLM response evaluation — supporting the training and fine-tuning of large language models. Applied structured evaluation rubrics to assess AI-generated content for accuracy, relevance, safety, and naturalness.

items.title: AI Response Auditing & Quality Assurance
items.description: Serving as an Auditor on the RWS Live S2S ELO project — a large-scale voice AI evaluation initiative comparing conversational AI models. Audit rater submissions using a comprehensive 5-point scoring rubric covering scenario adherence, conversational dynamics, naturalness, utility, and audio quality. Identify error clusters, validate dimension ratings, and write detailed evidence-based audit reports. This role demands meticulous attention to detail, deep understanding of conversational AI quality metrics, and the ability to make nuanced judgments across multiple evaluation dimensions.
